text: S586 separates product-source omissions from receiver observations. The selected-size writer has no explicit units, stable identity, mark IDs/labels, or grade relationships; these are profile-contract work, not a demonstrated cause of the five Polo CUT corner losses. CUT/SEW are already separate at source, while CLO mixes them in nine output layers. 78 marks lack direct geometry matches, which does not prove loss. Next: produce a source/profile-backed additive contract before any changed export; preserve legacy DXF and all V03 gates. See E-G04-S586-EXIT.
